description: Automatically saves and restores your .env file per git branch when switching branches.
config.enabled: Automatically swap the .env file when switching branches.
config.envFile: Name of the env file to find anywhere in the project (e.g. ".env"), or a path relative to the repo root (e.g. "backend/.env").
config.exclude: Folder names skipped when searching for env files.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
